x.description: A `Tensor` of a floating or integer dtype.
constraints: x and y must have broadcast-compatible shapes

y.description: A `Tensor` with the same dtype as `x` and a compatible shape.
constraints: y must have the same dtype as x
x and y must have broadcast-compatible shapes

output.description: The element-wise quotient as in `tf.math.divide(x, y)`, except that division by zero produces `0.0`, not `nan`.

constraints: x and y must have broadcast-compatible shapes
